id: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings (2021)

facts.text: Shaun, you never said your dad ran an army. Fine. Eat first, explain after.
facts.why: I know of no such Katy line, and no quote page could be opened in this run to match it. It is printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Katy does learn about Shaun's past after the bus attack, but the wording here reads as made up. No source could be opened for this film in this run (the search limit was reached), so this is judged from memory of the film.
facts.fix: Shaun, I'm still not over the bus. Eat first, then you can explain the rings and the army.
